compiled_state.title: As a brainstorm orchestrator, unmappable assumption findings surface via the SC Gap Check fallback
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a `Premise to confirm` line to the SC Gap Check prompt in plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md for assumption findings without a user-outcome SC mapping, with confirm/revise/accept-risk options. Add a structural test asserting no severity filter is applied to assumption findings between blue-team output and approval-gate rendering.

**Why**: NFR-style assumption findings (cost-tier, latency-tier) don't always map to user-outcome SCs. Without a fallback, these findings would be silently dropped at SC Gap Check time. The severity-floor non-regression test prevents future config changes from inadvertently filtering low/medium assumption findings.

**Scope**:
- IN: `Premise to confirm` line in SC Gap Check AskUserQuestion prompt for unmappable assumption findings; confirm/revise/accept-risk options; structural test asserting no severity filter is applied to assumption findings; explicit assertion that the schema enum value `"assumption"` (the value emitted by S3) is what the fallback consumes.
- OUT: Changes to SC Gap Check user-outcome-mapping logic for non-assumption findings.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md SC Gap Check section contains a `Premise to confirm` branch for assumption findings without user-outcome SC mapping, with confirm/revise/accept-risk options as documented, verified by structural test on the canonical phrases.
  ← Satisfies: "SC Gap Check fallback and severity-floor non-regression"
- When this story is complete, the SC Gap Check fallback prompt's `Premise to confirm` branch consumes findings whose schema enum value is exactly `"assumption"` (the value emitted by S3); structural test asserts the literal string `assumption` appears in both plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/scenario-red-team.md (emitter) and plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/post-scrutiny-handlers.md (consumer) and that no other category name is consumed by the fallback.
  ← Satisfies: "SC Gap Check fallback and severity-floor non-regression"
- When this story is complete, a structural test asserts no severity filter is applied to assumption findings between blue-team output and approval-gate rendering — verified by inspecting the SC Gap Check section for absence of severity-threshold comparisons that would exclude low/medium assumption findings.
  ← Satisfies: "SC Gap Check fallback and severity-floor non-regression"
- When this story is complete, a synthetic NFR-style assumption finding (e.g., latency-tier or cost-tier premise) without user-outcome SC mapping surfaces under the `Premise to confirm` line at the SC Gap Check prompt with all three response options.
  ← Satisfies: "SC Gap Check fallback and severity-floor non-regression"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] post-scrutiny-handlers.md SC Gap Check section is the canonical fallback path; changes here affect any future scenario category, not just `assumption`.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
